name: voicetotext
displayName: Voice to Text — Local Whisper Transcription
description: Record and transcribe speech to text locally using OpenAI Whisper. 100% private — no cloud, no API keys. macOS with Metal GPU acceleration.

commands.title: Voice to Text: Show Transcription History
Voice to Text: Switch Whisper Model

enumDescriptions: Large v3 Turbo — Best accuracy, multilingual, ~1.5 GB download. Slowest but most accurate.
Small (Multilingual) — Good balance of speed and accuracy, supports translation, ~466 MB download.
Small English — Fast with good accuracy, English only, ~466 MB download. Recommended for English dictation.
Base English — Fastest, English only, ~142 MB download. Good for quick notes.
voicetotext.model.description: Whisper model to use for transcription. Changing this will download the new model on next recording if not already present.

voicetotext.language.description: Language code for transcription (e.g. en, es, fr, de, ja, auto). Only applies to multilingual models like Large v3 Turbo.

voicetotext.audioDevice.description: macOS audio input device index for ffmpeg (e.g. 0, 1, 2). Leave empty to auto-detect the built-in microphone. Run 'ffmpeg -f avfoundation -list_devices true -i ""' in terminal to see available devices.

voicetotext.whisperCliPath.description: Custom path to a whisper-cli binary. Leave empty to use the auto-built one at ~/.voicetotext/whisper.cpp/.

voicetotext.modelPath.description: Custom path to a ggml model file. Leave empty to use ~/.voicetotext/models/.
